symptom: `retrieve $u from $task/System.owner;` (or System.changedBy) passed `check` and `exec`; mxbuild then failed `[CE0136] "Retrieve object must specify the 'Entity' property."` — with or without `owner: AutoOwner` on the entity. Issue mendixlabs/mxcli#1358 (11.12.2)
cause: owner/changedBy are HasOwner/HasChangedBy flags, not modelled associations. mxbuild resolves the NAME in an AssociationRetrieveSource (System.Owner is CE1613 instead, so lookup works) but derives no target entity from it, so the RetrieveAction has none. Nothing mxcli can write in that source builds
insight: The issue proposed writing `Entity: System.User` — there is no such property: AssociationRetrieveSource has only StartVariableName + AssociationId, and CE0136's 'Entity' is the entity Studio Pro DERIVES from the association. Measure alternatives with mx check before designing a writer fix: `[System.owner/M.Task = $task]` on System.User is CE0161 (system associations do not traverse in reverse in XPath), but `retrieve $u from System.User where [id = $task/System.owner] first;` builds clean for owner and changedBy. So the fix is a project-free refusal naming that rewrite, not a builder change. Not measured for nanoflows (rule is microflow-only)
